items.claim: 管理層稱 SoC TAM 上修的大部分來自推論應用
items.quote: most of the increase in the SoC TAM that we just announced is coming from more inference applications
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 管理層稱需求在今年與明年可持續
items.quote: We do see that to be sustainable throughout this year and into next year.
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 測試內容量增加來自測試時間與插入次數，尤其加速器的 3D 封裝
items.quote: additional test content increases through test times and additional insertions
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 加速器最終測試的測試時間高於 CPU
items.quote: the accelerator side on the final test is higher
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: TAM 上修以計算口徑而言，管理層認為難以拆成三個應用，並稱 GPU 目前仍最大
items.quote: right now, I would say GPU market is still the largest.
items.speaker: Unknown Executive

items.claim: 管理層提到過去未單獨拆分的網通（networking）區塊，並稱該區塊也大幅成長
items.quote: One segment that we have not talked about before that we didn't use to split networking.
items.speaker: Unknown Executive

items.claim: 管理層稱 93000 平台橫跨所有 CPU 客戶，市占在公司間移轉不相關
items.quote: we have a de facto standard in the 90000 across the entire CPU industry
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 10,000 台/年產能目標（原訂 2028 年底～2029 初）正在提前，新日期未定
items.quote: And we're pulling that in, not prepared yet to say how much we're pulling that in with a new date.
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 管理層承諾下一季提供更明確的產能擴張提前日期
items.quote: I expect next quarter to have a more clear date for when we'll bring in that production expansion.
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 5,000 台水準（原訂 2027 年 3 月底）將直接越過
items.quote: For 5000, it's safe to assume that we're going to flow right through that level at this point in time.
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 代工廠將在東南亞增設第二座工廠支援擴產
items.quote: our contract manufacturer is putting a second factory in Southeast Asia
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 記憶體測試機也有擴產計畫，且供應鏈挑戰較多（自製比重高）
items.quote: there's lots of programs within the company right now to expand on the memory side
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 管理層稱中期很可能在 10,000 台之後再做下一階擴產
items.quote: it's highly likely that we'll do another step on the capacity expansion
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 管理層表示下一階產能可能 15,000 或更高，將在未來幾季釐清
items.quote: It may be 15, it may be higher, but we'll try to clarify that in the coming quarters.
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 產能規劃一律內建緩衝
items.quote: we always will build in buffer into our production capacity planning
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 客戶在流片與特性分析前不知測試時間，是產能規劃的不確定因素
items.quote: there's unknowns, in particular, around test time.
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 管理層列出毛利有利因素：產品組合、匯率、規模經濟
items.quote: the product mix is favorable. I think we've had favorable exchange rates as well.
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: BOM 通膨為逆風，記憶體價格居首
items.quote: The headwinds right now, obviously, are some inflationary things on our bill of materials.
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 管理層解釋對全年毛利保守的理由是記憶體價格環境
items.quote: we have to be conservative because we are subject to the pricing environment on the memory
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 本季毛利含存貨呆滯回沖的一次性助益，非每季可預期
items.quote: we had some reversal of inventory obsolescence that was helpful to our margins in this particular quarter
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 明年記憶體價格壓力仍大，公司將逐案嘗試轉嫁部分成本
items.quote: we are working on certain areas where we can pass some of that along
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: SoC 市占 2025 年為 66%
items.quote: we reported for 2025 that we had 66% share
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 管理層稱未來可見 SoC 市占 70% 以上路徑
items.quote: We can see a path towards 70% plus on that in the future.
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 記憶體測試競爭較多，NAND 非傳統主場，部分新插入未取得
items.quote: There's more competition in the memory side.
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 管理層稱今年記憶體可能小幅下滑
items.quote: this year may represent a little bit of a downturn for the company
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 管理層對收回今年可能流失的記憶體市占表示有信心
items.quote: we are very confident that we will recover that loss over the next few years
items.speaker: Sanjeev Mohan

items.claim: 將推出數款關鍵記憶體產品，已有客戶承諾
items.quote: we already have customer commitments for those products
items.speaker: Sanjeev Mohan

items.claim: 管理層預期記憶體市場未來數年隨新廠投產明顯成長
items.quote: the memory market, we expect also to grow significantly next few years as the new fabs come online
items.speaker: Sanjeev Mohan

items.claim: 中國占總營收約 19%，含 SoC 與記憶體，本季約 80～85% 為 SoC
items.quote: China is about 19% of our total sales, and that is both SoC and memory.
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 中國新廠預計 2028 年前後投產，在此之前占比估計維持 20% 或以下
items.quote: we would stay in that 20% or lower of overall sales
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 客戶需求能見度由過去約 6 個月延長到約 18 個月
items.quote: it's much easier for us to see out, I would say, about 18 months
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

items.claim: 過去客戶提供的預測通常不超過 6 個月
items.quote: historically, we were never given really much more than a 6-month forecast
items.speaker: Douglas Lefever

qa_flags.question: Yamamoto（Mizuho）請拆解 TAM 上修 20 億美元與 SoC 測試機銷售上修在 ASIC／CPU／GPU 的各自貢獻
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給拆分數字，稱拆成三類太複雜、設備可互通，僅稱來自運算與推論成長

qa_flags.question: Shikanai（JPMorgan）追問 CPU 與加速器的測試時間／強度比較
qa_flags.response_pattern: 僅定性說加速器最終測試較高，明言不便提供明確數字

qa_flags.question: Nakamura（Goldman）詢問產能擴張是否比 4 月說法更快、新時程為何
qa_flags.response_pattern: 確認提前但不給新日期，稱仍在內部檢視、下季再回覆

qa_flags.question: Yoshida（CLSA）詢問今年與明年 SoC 與記憶體測試機市占展望
qa_flags.response_pattern: 不給數字（稱明年 4 月再公布），僅定性：SoC 向上、記憶體今年可能小幅下滑

qa_flags.question: Shibano（Citigroup）詢問後續季度與明年是否有毛利壓力
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給後續毛利水準，稱因記憶體價格仍不願預測與本季一致的毛利，轉嫁客戶稱為敏感話題
